meta.title: ESAIL | EU Society for AI Literacy

hero.title: AI literacy for a more informed, democratic Europe.
hero.subtitle: ESAIL is focused on advancing AI literacy across the European Union.

about.title: Helping societies prepare for an AI-powered future.
about.paragraph1: ESAIL brings together researchers, educators, civic organisations, policymakers, and citizens to improve understanding of artificial intelligence and its social impact.
about.paragraph2: We believe that AI literacy is not only a technical skill, but a public responsibility. By promoting critical thinking, ethical awareness, and practical knowledge, we support a Europe where people can participate in informed digital decisions.

mission.title: Promoting understanding and participation at every level.

education.title: Education
education.text: Supporting schools, universities, and lifelong learners with clear, accessible AI education.

ethics.title: Ethics
ethics.text: Encouraging responsible and transparent use of AI in public and private life.

participation.title: Participation
participation.text: Empowering citizens and communities to engage with digital policy and innovation.

focus.title: Where we work to strengthen AI literacy.

publicUnderstanding.title: Public understanding
publicUnderstanding.text: Clear explanations of how AI works, what it can and cannot do, and how it affects daily life.

policy.title: Policy & governance
policy.text: Helping citizens, institutions, and decision-makers understand AI regulation and accountability.

skills.title: Skills & training
skills.text: Building practical digital and AI competencies across education, work, and community settings.

access.title: Inclusive access
access.text: Ensuring AI literacy is accessible, multilingual, and relevant to diverse communities.

focus.quote: AI literacy is a foundation for democratic participation in the digital age.

join.title: Building an informed and resilient society.
